hypothesis: Complete positive intent coverage and individually sampled diverse NLI plus fresh QA and retention replay repair prefix/block sampling bias. No Phase 3 test predictions before frozen selection.
selection: Compare with the same frozen Phase 2 parent on new development. Prefer task-macro accuracy; inspect paired source-group uncertainty and retention. A gain of >=1 pp or recovery of >=5 pp in the weakest family without macro loss justifies a seed replication; material regressions require review. Freeze both baseline and selected candidate with per-model calibration before final test. No indefinite grid search.

development_robustness.scope: Predefined same perturbations applied to development for debugging; new final robustness remains sealed.
